description:
Markdown-based note-taking app for developers


Znote 4.10.0

✨ New look
New style redesign of the whole app: dark theme, Settings and every dialog, tree view, note list, outline, toolbars with new line icons, AI bar, recorder and command palettes. Lists now show a single highlight, and the Material ripple is gone.

🚀 Features
- Read-only mode and Live edit / Source toggle in the toolbar. In read mode, copying gives plain text and the AI bar is hidden.
- No more footer. Help, Settings and Account move to the vault bar, and the AI model picker moves into the Ask AI bar.
- NPM, Plugins, Functions and MCP are now tabs of Settings and no longer sit in the left bar.
- Quick search (Cmd/Ctrl+T) works again, as a keyboard-driven palette with recent notes and full-text results.
- Paste any file. PDFs and documents copied from the Finder or Explorer go into the vault's attachments folder with a [[link]] that opens them in the default app. On macOS, several files can be pasted at once.
- Show all file types: a new per-vault option that lists every file of the vault in the tree view.
- Focus mode: a button switches between the readable line length and full width for the focus session only.

🐛 Fixes
- PowerShell scripts are exported as .ps1.
- The organization sign-in dialog is now in English and shows login errors inline.
